title: Patroni: rolling cert rotation (8 nodes)
description: Runs `nexus cert-rotate postgres`: Vault re-issues a fresh leaf for every node (pki_int/issue/patroni-server) and reloads/restarts per role, leader last.

observe.what: all 8 nodes (3 PG + 3 etcd + 2 haproxy) show a new serial; PG reloads (SIGHUP), etcd restarts, haproxy reloads; leader rotates last. Live: ~55s.

whatProves: PatroniAdapter.RotateCertAsync re-issues from the single PKI role patroni-server (domain patroni.nexus.lab for all nodes -- ADR-0013 bug #4) and applies per-role reload vs restart.
